title: Webhook management commands
goal: Give workspace admins CLI commands to manage outgoing webhooks and to check signatures locally, handling the show-once signing secret correctly.
scope_in: `centcom webhooks list|show|create|update|delete|test|deliveries|redeliver|rotate-secret` mapped to GET/POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/webhooks, GET/PATCH/DELETE /v1/webhooks/{id}, POST .../test, GET .../deliveries, POST .../deliveries/{dlv}/redeliver (rotate via PATCH `rotate_secret:true`).

`create` requires `--url` (https) and `--event` (repeatable) validated against the v1 event types in CT-WEBHOOKS; sends an `Idempotency-Key` (required) and prints the returned signing secret exactly once.
Output: tables and `--json`; deliveries show id, event type, attempt, status, time; `--workspace <wsp_id>` defaults to the active workspace from /v1/me.
Pre-checks: `webhooks_max` from entitlements (display only) and role hint (admin+); friendly mapping of `forbidden`, `entitlement_*`, `idempotency_conflict`.

`centcom webhooks verify --secret-stdin --signature <header value> --body-file <path> [--tolerance 300]`: implements the receiver check from CT-WEBHOOKS (`v1 = HMAC_SHA256(secret, t + '.' + raw_body)`, reject if |now - t| > 300 s, accept any `v1` during rotation overlap) for local debugging.
scope_out: Sending webhooks and retries (real backend). Webhook management UI: lane C091.
HTTP plumbing and auth: lanes C051, C052. Audit viewer: lane C070.
Hosting a local receiver endpoint (not provided).
build_against: the mock backend (lane C007): REST from OpenAPI plus the WebSocket relay simulator, started in-process with `startMockBackend()` from @centcom/testkit; no real backend is needed. The mock manages in-memory webhook endpoints, returns the secret once on create/rotate, serves delivery logs and signature fixtures from contracts/fixtures/webhooks/ (valid, expired timestamp, wrong secret, overlap with two v1 values).
interfaces: `registerWebhookCommands(program, deps: { http: HttpClient; io; isTTY: boolean })`
`verifyWebhookSignature(o: { secret: string; header: string; rawBody: Uint8Array; nowS: number; toleranceS?: number }): { ok: boolean; reason?: 'malformed'|'stale'|'mismatch' }` (constant-time)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 auth required, 3 verification failed (`verify`)
acceptance: `webhooks create --url https://example.com/h --event session.created` sends one POST with an `Idempotency-Key`, prints the secret once on a TTY, and a second `show` never prints it; in non-TTY mode the secret is printed only with `--show-secret`, otherwise a message explains it cannot be shown again and exit code is still 0.
`--url http://example.com` and any non-https URL are rejected locally before any request (exit 1), except `http://localhost`/`127.0.0.1` with an explicit `--allow-localhost`.
`--event` values outside the CT-WEBHOOKS v1 list (e.g. `foo.bar`) are rejected locally with the list of valid types; all 20+ listed types are accepted (table-driven from the contract).
A retried create (forced 502) reuses the same Idempotency-Key; `idempotency_conflict` is shown as a clear message.
`delete` asks for confirmation on a TTY and requires `--yes` otherwise; `rotate-secret` prints the new secret once and states the 24 h overlap.
`deliveries` pages through results with cursor pagination and `--limit` up to 200; `redeliver` posts with an idempotency key and reports the new attempt.
`verify` returns exit 0 for the valid fixture, 3 for stale timestamp (|now - t| > 300), wrong secret and malformed header; accepts when either of two `v1=` values matches (overlap).
`--json` output of every command validates against documented shapes and never includes the secret except create/rotate with the show-once rule; no command logs the secret.
Using the commands as a non-admin yields the mapped `forbidden` message with exit 1 and no stack trace; when `webhooks_max` is reached the message names the limit.
tests: webhooks/commands.test.ts: every subcommand against the mock incl. pagination.
webhooks/secret.test.ts: show-once semantics, TTY vs non-TTY, redaction in logs/json.
webhooks/validation.test.ts: URL and event-type validation tables.
webhooks/signature.test.ts: contract signature fixtures, tolerance, overlap, constant-time compare path, fuzz of header parsing.
guardrails: MUST print a signing secret at most once per create/rotate, MUST NOT write it to disk, config, shell history hints or logs, and MUST NOT include it in `--json` unless `--show-secret` was given.
MUST require https endpoints (CT-WEBHOOKS) and MUST NOT disable that check silently.
MUST compare HMAC values in constant time and enforce the 300 s tolerance in `verify`; MUST read the secret from stdin, never from an argv value.
MUST NOT print request/response bodies of deliveries that could contain secrets; delivery logs show metadata only.
MUST ask before deleting (or require `--yes`) and MUST NOT prompt without a TTY.
failure_modes: Secret lost -> only recovery is `rotate-secret`; the command says so.
Endpoint marked failing/disabled by the server -> `show` surfaces status and last failure code; commands still work.
Workspace not resolved (not in any workspace) -> exit 1 asking for `--workspace`.
